changes.title: Ground variants
items: The ground no longer repeats: every area's floor comes in four versions, mixed across the ground with no seams

changes.title: Crowns style
items: With ?style=bold or ?style=ref the oaks, beeches, limes and other broadleaf trees get the pixel-art look too: each crown lit as one shape, bright on its top-left and shaded below, with clustered tones

changes.title: Ground gen
items: The ground in every area is grown by a new ground generator: moss in lit domes on the moor, pine needles and twigs, mud with little puddles, pebbles and slabs on the stony ground, fallen leaves, grass tufts, heather and bluebells, each in its area's own colours
With ?style=bold or ?style=ref the ground gets the pixel-art look too
